annotations.title: Look up gas leaf blower rules

description: Lists adopted local laws that ban or restrict gas leaf blowers in one US state, or one city or town in it, from EosLog's sourced table: the rule, when it took or takes effect and any later phases, who is cited, the penalty, and the official sources with the date each row was checked. Also reports a state law that blocks local bans (Florida, Georgia, and Texas). Without a city it lists every place in the state briefly; pass city for the full row. A place with no row may still have a rule EosLog has not confirmed.

city.description: Optional city, town, village or county name, for example Los Angeles.

state.description: Two-letter code (CA) or full name (California). DC is included.
